openItems.conversionImpact: enables explicit v600/v700 output for supported entities; unsupported entities fail by default
openItems.releaseDecision: publish as a bounded writer without a universal JWW compatibility claim
openItems.title: JWW save/write
openItems.detail: Gateway writes internal versions 600 and 700 from Gateway JSON, including native CDataSunpou dimensions, CDataBlock/CDataList blocks, external image references, and v700 embedded image payloads.
openItems.evidence: writer tests and the generated entity-family corpus parse and semantically compare v600/v700 output; Jw_cad 10.02.1 also reopened native block and embedded-image fixtures.
openItems.nextAction: Add independently authored real drawings and record Jw_cad reopen/resave evidence for every supported entity family and target Jw_cad release.

openItems.conversionImpact: high for exact import claims; current bundled samples do not cover current Jw_cad versions or the full entity set
openItems.releaseDecision: do not claim version-wide or round-trip compatibility from the bundled corpus
openItems.title: JWW version and entity conformance corpus
openItems.detail: The generated round-trip corpus covers seven v600 and eight v700 fixtures across line, arc/circle/ellipse, text/point, solid, dimension, block, and image families. Local Jw_cad drawings remain separate and are not redistributed.
openItems.evidence: npm run roundtrip:corpus requires parser-clean drawing and document semantic equality for every generated fixture; npm run verify:conformance separately records observed real-file parse coverage.
openItems.nextAction: Add Jw_cad-produced fixtures for each target application version and entity family, then record reopen and resave evidence separately.
